FloPlast boss adaptors are crucial plumbing components engineered for connecting waste pipes to soil stack systems efficiently. These durable rubber adaptors are specifically designed to facilitate the secure integration of 32mm waste pipes into 110mm soil stack drainage, making them an ideal solution for trade professionals undertaking various plumbing installations. Supplied in a convenient 5-pack, these black FloPlast rubber adaptors ensure a robust and leak-free connection, vital for effective wastewater management and long-term reliability in various building projects.
